content.title: Netherlands vs. Norway Friendly Lineups, Live Streaming, How & Where to Watch on TV
content.text: The Netherlands faces Norway on Friday, March 27, at 12:45 p.m. PT, 3:45 p.m. ET in an international friendly at Johan Cruyff Arena.Both national teams are preparing for the FIFA World Cup. The Netherlands secured its World Cup qualification, which will take place in the United States, after beating Lithuania 4-0 in November of last year.AdvertisementNorway, for its part, ended a 28-year wait to qualify for a World Cup again. The Nordic team won all eight games, scoring 37 goals, 16 of which were scored by Erling Haaland.Here is all the key pre-match information, including how and where to watch live, predicted lineups, TV and streaming details.Alexander Sorloth of Norway and Morten Thorsby of Norway celebrate after winning at the end of the FIFA World Cup 2026 qualifier match between Italy and Norway at San Siro Stadium on November 16, 2025, in Milan, Italy. Photo by Matteo Ciambelli/DeFodi Images/DeFodi via Getty Images (Photo by Matteo Ciambelli/DeFodi Images/DeFodi via Getty Images)The Netherlands vs. Norway match will be available to watch on both television and streaming platforms. In the United States, you can enjoy it through Fox Soccer Plus, fuboTV, ViX, and FOX One.AdvertisementIn the UK and Ireland, it will be available on Amazon Prime Video, while in Canada, you can tune in on DAZN and fuboTV.CountryTV Channel / StreamingUnited StatesFox Soccer Plus, fuboTV, ViX, FOX OneUnited KingdomAmazon Prime VideoIreland RepublicAmazon Prime VideoCanadaDAZN Canada, fuboTV CanadaNorwayTV 2 Direkte, TV 2 PlayNetherlandsNPO 3, Ziggo Go, NPO Start, Canal+ NetherlandsPredicted Lineups for Netherlands and NorwayNetherlandsGoalkeeper: Verbruggen.Defenders: Dumfries, Van Dijk, Van de Ven, Ake.Midfielders: Gravenberch, Schouten, Simons, Reijnders, Gakpo.Forwards: Malen.NorwayGoalkeeper: Nyland.Defenders: Ryerson, Ostigard, Ajer, Bjorkan.Midfielders: Bobb, Berg, Berge, Hauge.Forwards: Strand Larsen, Sorloth.This story was originally published by Athlon Sports on Mar 27, 2026, where it first appeared in the Soccer section.
